parts.passageContent:
Most birds are believed to migrate seasonally.

Hibernation theory
• It was believed that birds hibernated underwater or buried themselves in _____(30)_____ .
• This theory was later disproved by experiments on caged birds.

Transmutation theory
• Aristotle believed birds changed from one species into another in summer and winter.
– In autumn he observed that redstarts experience the loss of _____(31)_____ and thought they then turned into robins.
– Aristotle's assumptions were logical because the two species of birds had a similar _____(32)_____ .

17th century
• Charles Morton popularised the idea that birds fly to the _____(33)_____ in winter.

Scientific developments
• In 1822, a stork was killed in Germany which had an African spear in its _____(34)_____ .
– previously there had been no _____(35)_____ that storks migrate to Africa
